children: Trilogy Metals announced the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers published a Notice of Intent to prepare an Environmental Impact Statement for its Arctic Project, formally commencing NEPA review and public scoping.
USACE publishes Notice of Intent to prepare an EIS for the Arctic Project, formally starting federal NEPA review.
Publication launches public scoping phase to solicit input from local residents, Tribes, stakeholders and agencies.
NOI milestone aligns with FAST-41 coordinated federal/state permitting schedule published July 2026.
Schedule targets draft EIS in October 2027 and Record of Decision in September 2028, with overall completion targeted November 2028.
